# Belmond

> > Belmond offers luxury hotels, trains, river cruises, and safaris across iconic destinations worldwide, from the Hiram Bingham train to Machu Picchu to safari lodges in Africa and heritage properties across Europe.

Belmond specializes in exceptional travel experiences combining luxury accommodations with cultural immersion. The collection includes legendary properties like Villa San Michele in Florence, Hotel Cipriani in Venice, the British Pullman train, and safari lodges in Botswana, alongside curated itineraries and destination guides.

## Key Topics

- Belmond luxury hotels
- Train journeys (Hiram Bingham, British Pullman)
- Safari experiences in Africa
- Villa San Michele Florence
- Italian Riviera (Portofino)
- Destination guides and travel inspiration
- Machu Picchu and Peru travel
- Wellness and culture travel
- Chobe National Park safaris
- Venice and Hotel Cipriani
- Art and design travel
- Sustainable luxury travel
- Culinary experiences
- Multi-destination itineraries
